text: Agents can self-register using a human email and receive an API key, inbox ID, and org ID
quote: The agent registers itself using the human email you provide and gets back an API key, inbox ID, and organization ID.

text: Supports creating large numbers of inboxes programmatically for agents on demand
quote: You can create tens, hundreds, or even thousands of Inboxes for your agents on demand.

text: Agents can send a message from an inbox to start a new email conversation
quote: To start a new conversation, you can send a Message from one of your inboxes.

text: Can cc or bcc a real human on agent-sent messages for human-in-the-loop oversight
quote: You can cc or bcc a real person on any message your agent sends, creating a "human-in-the-loop" workflow for oversight, escalations, or quality assurance.

text: Full-text search finds threads by keyword across sender, recipients, subject, and body, ranked by relevance
quote: Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.

text: Can register a webhook URL to receive POST notifications instead of polling for new email
quote: Instead of constantly asking the AgentMail API if there's a new email (a process called polling), you can register a URL, and we will send you a POST request

text: Provides a persistent WebSocket connection for real-time email event delivery
quote: WebSockets provide a persistent, bidirectional connection to AgentMail for receiving email events in real-time.

text: Inboxes can be connected to standard mail clients like Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP client
quote: Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox

text: Supports creating a dedicated pod per customer with routed webhook events for multi-tenant setups
quote: create a Pod per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.

text: Scoped API keys can restrict access to a single pod or single inbox
quote: Scoped API keys restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox.

text: Supports custom sending domains to control sending reputation for production use
quote: using your own custom domains is essential for production applications. It gives you control over your sending reputation, which is the single most important factor in reaching the inbox.

text: Runs a hosted MCP server exposing inbox, message, thread, draft, and attachment tools
quote: AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, and attachment tools to any compatible client.

text: Can create inboxes, send messages, and manage threads without writing code
quote: Create inboxes, send messages, manage threads, and more — all without writing code.
